Meta.title: Vinicius Belchior — Software Engineer
Meta.description: Portfolio of Vinicius Belchior — Software Engineer & Data Analyst. Python, Django, React, Next.js, TypeScript.

Hero.descPart2: I build scalable platforms, smart automations and products with real business impact in high-complexity environments.

About.p1: I'm a Full Stack developer with solid experience in scalable projects, process automation and data analysis applied to high-complexity businesses. I work with Python (Django, Pandas, NumPy) on the backend, JavaScript/TypeScript with React.js/Next.js on the frontend, and R for statistical modeling.
About.p2: I've worked on portfolios with monthly revenue above R$ 1M, built analytical reports that reduced mean time to resolution, and based on data analysis, helped teams hit the best historical performance marks at Mapfre, Volkswagen and Honda accounts.
About.p3: Focus on quality, scalability and direct business impact. With RESTful APIs, WebSockets, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Azure infrastructure with CI/CD.

Achievements.intro: Engineering, math and teamwork that preceded my life in software — and still shape how I think about critical systems today.
Achievements.projectMeta: 17 years old · high school · ETEC Bauru
Achievements.projectDescription: As the capstone project of my technical degree in Systems Development, I built, with 4 friends, a rocket that competed at LASC (Latin American Space Challenge), the largest rocketry competition in Latin America, in the 500-meter category. We were the only high-school team competing in that category.
Achievements.roleDescription: Responsible for aerodynamic drag calculations, descent trajectory prediction and parachute sizing, ensuring the rocket completed the round trip safely and on time, accounting for wind disturbances and thrust loss.
Achievements.quote: I learned early that critical projects don't depend on a single person — they depend on math, on safety margins and on a team that trusts every gear of the system.

WorkAchievements.intro: Every delivery here started from a real problem, solved with engineering, data and a focus on outcomes.
WorkAchievements.item1Short: R automation + Power BI dashboard that turned a fully manual process into instant monitoring.
WorkAchievements.item1Long: The internal monitoring platform was completely manual: slow, error-prone and with no historical visibility. I built an R automation that pulled raw data, cleaned and transformed it, and fed a Power BI dashboard adopted by the whole team. The dashboard included desktop alerts when error volumes crossed critical thresholds. The result was a shift from blind spots — where nobody knew exactly what was happening — to strategic resolution based on metrics and critical-point analysis.
WorkAchievements.item2Short: Python script that fully automated internal report extraction and formatting — now the company standard.
WorkAchievements.item2Long: All internal reports were generated manually: open the platform, configure filters, wait for processing, export and format. That cycle consumed hours per week across the whole team. I built a Python script that automated every step — extraction, transformation and formatting — delivering files already in the correct standard. The solution became the official report extraction process adopted company-wide.
WorkAchievements.item3Title: Records at Mapfre, VW and Honda
WorkAchievements.item3Short: Data analysis uncovered a client-segment opportunity, driving all-time highs across all three portfolios simultaneously.
WorkAchievements.item3Long: With automated reports in hand, I started analyzing behavioral patterns across the portfolios. I identified a specific client segment with high conversion probability that was being underutilized in the outreach strategy. Based on that analysis, the team adjusted its focus and all three portfolios — Mapfre, Volkswagen and Honda — hit their best historical results simultaneously, surpassing R$ 1M in monthly revenue.
WorkAchievements.item4Short: Python engine + Next.js interface simulating real service scenarios for operator training.
WorkAchievements.item4Long: Operators needed practical training but the traditional format had low engagement. I built an institutional game with a Python logic engine and a Next.js interface that simulated real negotiation scenarios — with dynamic variables, immediate feedback and scoring. The game was used for onboarding and refresher training, increasing training engagement and improving operator performance in the first weeks.
WorkAchievements.item5Tag: Full Stack Dev III · Python & Azure
WorkAchievements.item5Short: Refactoring, Docker, observability and internalization of a service that cost the company R$ 2M per year.
WorkAchievements.item5Long: The internal system had accumulated technical debt: no code standards, no containerization, no observability, and a dependency on a high-cost external service. I led code standardization and optimization with best practices, implemented Docker for portability and environment consistency, and configured observability and security on Azure. The highest-impact move was fully internalizing the external service into our own infrastructure, eliminating R$ 2 million per year in operational costs.
